CustomObject.description: A generic Category/Key/Value config store for the Quote Document framework, so a new small lookup table (a product-to-label map, a rate table, a name override) never needs its own Custom Metadata Type or Apex change - it needs a Category and some rows. Read with QuoteDocumentKeyValueMap.get(category), which returns Key__c -> Value__c for every active row in that category. Not a replacement for Quote_Document_Table_Def__mdt or Quote_Document_Grouping__mdt - those stay their own types because their structure is fixed and richer than Category/Key/Value.
CustomObject.label: Quote Document Key Value
